text:
alex.g: Heads-up — PR #19912 is green locally and the docs changes are done. We need to land it before Tuesday's maintenance blackout in us-west. CI keeps stalling on the integration job (macOS). Anyone available to give quick eyes or help with a rerun? :wave:

maria.k: I can take a look in ~30m. Which tests are failing?

alex.g: Thanks! Failing job is mac-integration-3. Log snippet:
```
FAIL test_auth_flow.py::TestAuth::test_token_refresh - AssertionError: token expired
... timeout waiting for mock-oauth (seen 3x)
```

sam.t: That mock service flaked earlier today. Usually a rerun clears it. I'll queue a rerun if we get +1s.

ci-bot: mac-integration-3 rerun requested by sam.t — queued (build #4521)

jen.l: If the rerun is green I can approve. If it flakes again maybe we should back out the mock dependency change in this PR and patch after the blackout.

maria.k: Looking through the diff now. If rebase required for docs conflict I can do it. Are we expecting any db migration window? Not for this change.

alex.g: No migrations. Rebase might be needed because main got a tiny docs tweak — should be trivial.

ci-bot: mac-integration-3 build #4521 started — running tests

sam.t: If build is green and jen approves, can someone merge and trigger the canary before 10:00 PT? That's the start of the blackout.

jen.l: I'll watch. If green and no regressions I'll add my approval and merge. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: mac-integration-3 build #4521 succeeded — all tests passed

maria.k: Rebased and pushed a tiny conflict fix. alex.g, can you confirm no changes to behavior?

alex.g: Confirmed — just docs conflict resolved.

jen.l: Approved. Merging now.

ci-bot: Merge started for PR #19912 by jen.l — deploying canary

sam.t: Canary smoke looks fine. Good job all. We'll monitor during the blackout but fallback plan is to rollback to previous release if any issues appear.

alex.g: Thanks everyone :heart:
